Text: The support console shall display the points history of a member for the last 24 months.
Rationale: Support answers balance disputes from the history.

Text: The support console shall show, for each points transaction in the history, the date, the store, the transaction type, the points and the balance after the transaction.
Rationale: Agents explain each balance change to the member.

Text: WHEN a member opens the points history in the customer mobile app, the app shall show the transactions of the last 24 months, newest first.
Rationale: Mirrors the support console view for members.
